full_name: Eun-Ah Kim | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2022–2023 Physical Sciences Edward, Frances, and Shirley B. Daniels Fellow Cornell University
bio: Eun-Ah Kim is a physicist whose research interests lie in the theoretical study of the collective phenomena condensed matter systems exhibit—and in understanding how such phenomena emerges from microscopic physics.
